title: 003 家庭聚会004 你不会看上人家了吧
slug: 从小欢喜开启诸天之旅
content_zh:
校门口，舅舅刘铮正在车上等着他们。
陆泽跟季杨杨两个人朝舅舅挥了挥手，然后就一左一右坐到了车的后排。
驾驶座上的刘铮从后视镜里看着自己这两个外甥，高兴的说道：
“小泽，你今天在学校待得还适应吗？平时没事的时候就让你弟弟多带着你在学校附近转一转，熟悉熟悉环境。”
当事人陆泽还未说话，旁边的季杨杨率先抢过话茬：
“哎呀，你快别说了舅舅，今天我表哥一下课，就有好多的女孩子围着他要微信，我看他是非常适应。”
只有在自己这个舅舅的面前，季杨杨才能展现出来他孩子心性的那一面。
陆泽满脸无奈。
刘铮听到后哈哈大笑起来。
“那是应该的。”
“这小泽啊，跟舅舅我年轻时候一样帅。”
“你俩在后面记得系上安全带，一会儿咱们等到了酒店再唠嗑，你们姥姥跟姥爷都在那里等着我们呢。”
......
这個时间点的京都显然是处于晚高峰，原本十几分钟的车程硬生生被拖了四十分钟。
但是车上一舅舅俩外甥三个人倒是聊的挺开心，刘铮这个舅舅快跟陆泽处成了哥们一样。
来到酒店，进入包厢。
陆泽看到了自己姥姥跟姥爷挨着坐在一起，而在两位老人的身边坐着的是他的小姨刘静。
“姥姥，姥爷，小姨。”
陆泽笑着朝长辈打了声招呼。
刘静立刻朝着陆泽挥了挥手，她的眼神里满是疼爱：“来来来小泽，坐在中间，让小姨好好看看伱，你是不是瘦了呀？”

姥爷跟小姨两个人的情绪热切但正常。
而这时候，一身花布衣裳、身材十分瘦小的姥姥看着身边这孩子，似乎想起来了自己那个已经过世的女儿，老人有些浑浊的眼里有泪光闪烁。
从坐下以后，陆泽的右手一直紧紧的被旁边的姥姥握在其中。
刘静此时倒是察觉到了母亲的情绪变化，轻声道：“好了妈，今天大家聚在一起是给小泽这孩子接风的，您也开心点。”
季杨杨进来也朝姥姥、姥爷乖巧的打了声招呼，然后在刘铮的提醒下，朝着刘静小声的叫了声妈。
刘静笑着点了点头，让儿子坐在了自己另一边。
在这种家庭的饭局里，刘铮是当之无愧的活宝。
老小子很快就把包厢里的气氛搞得火热起来，期间还调侃了陆泽刚刚入学第一天就被要微信的事情。
这让刘静使劲的给不着调的弟弟使着眼神。
众人聊了许久，期间服务员进来好几次询问是否要点菜。
而季杨杨的情绪变得更加低沉，陆泽知道这是因为今天的饭局上还少了一个重要的人。
季胜利。
刘铮小声朝刘静问道：“姐，是不是姐夫在来的路上堵车了啊？刚刚我们来的时候就堵了好大一会儿，要不咱们再等一会儿？”
刘静掏出手机，打开微信看着丈夫刚刚发来的信息，抬头轻声道：“胜利他临时有个会，在区里面暂时来不了了，我们大家先吃吧。”
content_en:
At the school gate, uncle Liu Zheng was waiting for them in the car.
Lu Ze and Ji Yangyang waved to their uncle, and then sat in the back row of the car.
Liu Zheng, who was in the driver's seat, looked at his two nephews in the rearview mirror and said happily:
"Ozawa, are you getting used to being at school today? When you have nothing to do, I ask your brother to take you around the school to familiarize yourself with the environment."
Before the person involved, Lu Ze, spoke, Ji Yangyang next to him took the lead and started talking:
"Oh, please stop talking about uncle. As soon as my cousin got into get out of class today, a lot of girls gathered around him asking for WeChat. I think he is very adaptable."
Only in front of his uncle, Ji Yangyang could show the side of his child's nature.
Lu Ze looked helpless.
Liu Zheng burst out laughing after hearing this.
"That's as it should be."
"This Ozawa is as handsome as my uncle when I was young."
"You two remember to fasten your seat belts in the back. We'll chat later when we get to the hotel. Your grandma and grandpa are waiting for us there."
...
Kyoto was obviously in the evening rush hour at this time, and the originally ten-minute drive was dragged to forty minutes.
But the three people in the car, an uncle, two nephews, were chatting happily. The uncle Liu Zheng and Lu Zechu were almost like buddies.
Come to the hotel and enter the box.
Lu Ze saw his grandma and grandpa sitting next to each other, and sitting next to the two old people was his aunt Liu Jing.
"Grandma, grandpa, aunt."
Lu Ze smiled and said hello to the elders.
Liu Jing immediately waved to Lu Ze, her eyes full of love: "Come on, Xiao Ze, sit in the middle, let aunt take a good look at you, have you lost weight?"
Grandpa and aunt were in an eager but normal mood.
At this time, a very thin grandma wearing floral clothes looked at the child beside her, seeming to think of her deceased daughter. Tears shone in the old man's muddy eyes.
Ever since he sat down, Lu Ze's right hand has been tightly held by the grandmother next to him.
Liu Jing noticed the change in her mother's mood at this time, and said softly: "Okay, Mom, we are all gathered together today to support this child Ozawa. You should also be happy."
Ji Yangyang came in and said hello to her grandma and grandpa obediently, and then at Liu Zheng's reminder, she called Liu Jing "Mom" in a low voice.
Liu Jing smiled and nodded, letting her son sit on the other side of her.
In this kind of family dinner, Liu Zheng is a well-deserved treasure.
The old boy quickly heated up the atmosphere in the box. During this period, he also teased Lu Ze about being asked to use WeChat on his first day at school.
This made Liu Jing wink hard at her inconspicuous brother.
Everyone chatted for a long time, during which the waiter came in several times and asked if he wanted to order.
Ji Yangyang's mood became even lower, and Lu Ze knew it was because there was an important person missing from today's dinner.
Ji victory.
Liu Zheng asked Liu Jing in a low voice: "Sister, was my brother-in-law stuck in a traffic jam on the way here? There was a big traffic jam when we came here just now. How about we wait a little longer?"
Liu Jing took out her mobile phone, opened WeChat and looked at the message her husband had just sent. She raised her head and whispered softly: "Shengli has a meeting at the last minute. He is in the area and can't come for the time being. Let's all eat first."
